description: This file defines the internal Smarty class Smary_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultTemplateHandler, including methods for registering a default template handler and retrieving default content from templates or configuration resources.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultTemplateHandler
classes.description: Defines methods for registering a default template handler and retrieving default templates, encapsulating related functionalities for Smarty templates.

methods.name: registerDefaultTemplateHandler
methods.description: Registers a default template handler callback for a Smarty template object, validating that the callback is callable.

methods.name: _getDefaultTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves default template content or configuration, handling file existence, content loading, and exception throwing for errors.
